newsitem.title: UK: Chiroscience up after Sunday press comment.
newsitem.headline: Chiroscience up after Sunday press comment.

text.p: Shares in Chiroscience Group Plc rose in pre-market trading on Monday, after the Sunday Times highlighted a biotechnology review by Townsley & Co and said Chiroscience was the brokerage's favourite stock in the sector.
Chiroscience shares were up 10-1/2p at 271-1/2 by 0716 GMT in volume of 57,635 shares.

The Sunday Times said Townsley argued that the biotech sector was poised to soar after being mostly out of favour for the past year and picked Chiroscience as having the best pipeline of new products.
Others it favoured were Biocompatibles Plc, Cantab Pharmaceuticals Plc, Celsis International Plc, PPL Therapeutics Plc, Scotia Holdings Plc and Shire Pharmaceuticals Plc.
